title: Longitudinal Analysis of C elegans (L4, YA D2 & YA D5)
author: Priota Islam
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bbk2ikye

steps.title: Synchronize C. elegans
steps.instruction: Bleach synchronize the worms following the 'Bleach synchronisation of C. elegans' protocol.

steps.title: Refeed L1 larvae
steps.instruction: Refeed the arrested L1s 2 days prior to tracking, using 3 plates per strain.

steps.title: Prepare imaging plates
steps.instruction: Seed imaging plates with 50ul OP50 and allow them to dry on the bench top or in the hood.

steps.title: Image worms at specific stages
steps.instruction: Image the strains at L4, Day 2, and Day 5 stages.

substeps.instruction: Pick 5 worms per imaging plate on the day of imaging.
Place worms on the Phenix rig to acclimatize for 30 minutes.

steps.title: Transfer worms for Day 5 tracking
steps.instruction: On Day 2 of tracking, transfer approximately 40 worms from each strain onto 2 new plates for Day 5 tracking to prevent overcrowding and ensure age differentiation.
